title: Honua MCP tool roster v1
description: The canonical honua-server /mcp tool roster, generated by scripts/generate-mcp-tool-roster.sh and guarded by McpToolRosterDriftTests. Downstream repositories gate tools/list parity on it.

serverSha.description: The honua-server commit the roster body was last regenerated from. Restamped only when the body changes.

generatedAt.description: UTC time the roster body was last regenerated.

regenerate.description: The command that regenerates this file.

static.description: Hand-authored IMcpTool names, with every capability gate enabled.

projectedAdmin.description: honua_admin_* tools the default production composition publishes: the audited Admin projection manifest plus the closed operator roster, minus AdminMcpOperationExclusions.

requiresDurableControlPlane.description: The subset of projectedAdmin that registers only when a durable operation-proposal store exists (AdminApiOperationCatalog and AdminConnectImportOperationCatalog membership).

views.description: Members of each server-authored workflow view, projected over static and projectedAdmin.

retired.description: Tool names the server no longer advertises. A consumer that still names one is stale.
